incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for customer 'ArcadiaHealth' on dedicated-west-2a. 5m error rate 18% (threshold 5%). Alert rule: dedicated->http:errors_high. Dash: https://redwood.monitor/alerts/3520004321

Eli (oncall): on it. paging SREs + runtime. starting quick triage — collecting traces and top-ips. can someone drop the recent deploy status?

Maya (sre): I'm awake, joining. any indication of noisy tenant or infra issue? KV evictions up?

Anna (customer-success): Arcadia says their customers are seeing a lot of 502/504s and some requests stuck in client retries. They've started routing jobs away. They asked if it's on our side.

Jordan (eng-runtime): pulling recent runtime metrics. KV cache eviction rate spiked 8x at 09:12 UTC. inflight queue for cluster-west-2a at ~950 (capacity 1024). heavy tail from tenant 'ml-optimizer' doing large batched requests. sample logs: ```
[09:12:37] ERR request_id=tx-9a3f gateway_error: downstream 502 model-kernel
[09:12:38] WARN tenant=ml-optimizer batch_size=512 latency=12000ms
[09:12:39] INFO kvcache evict key=prefix-ml-optimizer count=2048
[09:12:40] ERR inflight_queue=948 capacity=1024 backpressure=true
```

Luis (ops): looks like capacity exhaustion from one tenant. We have a couple standard mitigations: 1) throttle/evict the noisy tenant 2) route Arcadia to fallback pool 3) temporarily scale dedicated pool if spare nodes available. Any preference?

Eli (oncall): prioritize customer impact: Arcadia is actively user-facing. Jordan, can we fallback Arcadia to a compatible smaller model-variant (quantized) with same API? that's usually fastest and lower resource. Also apply tenant throttles for 'ml-optimizer'.

Jordan (eng-runtime): yes we have a quantized v1-small variant that is API-compatible. routing change is straightforward. Also can push tenant throttle via admin API. commands below: ```
# throttle tenant (rate limit concurrent requests)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://admin.internal/tenants/ml-optimizer/actions/throttle -d '{"concurrency":10,"burst":20}'

# route Arcadia to fallback pool
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://admin.internal/routing -d '{"customer":"ArcadiaHealth","target_pool":"dedicated-west-2a-quantized"}'

# scale pool +2 nodes
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCALE" https://infra.internal/pools/dedicated-west-2a/scale -d '{"add":2}'
```

Eli (oncall): executing throttle now. I'll also notify Arcadia of temporary routing.

Eli (oncall): (ran throttle) ```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"tenant":"ml-optimizer","concurrency":10,"burst":20,"status":"applied"}
```

deploy-bot: Routing policy update applied: route-id=rt-arcadia-3520004321 -> dedicated-west-2a-quantized (initiated by Eli). (reaction :white_check_mark:)

Jordan (eng-runtime): verified: Arcadia traffic now hitting quantized pool. backend 5xx spike has moved to the heavy tenant traces. KV eviction rate decreasing.

Maya (sre): I'm taking the remainder of the investigation and mitigation. Eli — handing off on-call. Eli, please add a short incident note and the paging ladder.

Eli (oncall): handing off to Maya for next 30m. Incident note: applied tenant throttle to ml-optimizer, moved Arcadia to quantized pool, requested ops scale +2 (pending). Pager duty: escalations enabled. Ticket: INC-2026-Arcadia.

Luis (ops): started scale request — AWS ASG request kicked, expected 3-6m for nodes to join. Meanwhile we should keep throttle for noisy tenant and monitor tail latencies.

Anna (customer-success): notified Arcadia support: "We've routed traffic to a lower-latency model and applied controls on noisy traffic. We're monitoring now; we'll update within 10 minutes." (customer asked to avoid rollback).

Maya (sre): metrics update: 5m error rate now 4.1% (was 18%), 10m error rate trending down. inflight queue at 420. KV evictions reduced to baseline. Still seeing occasional spikes from ml-optimizer but throttles are holding.

Eli (oncall): good work. please call if it regresses. final remediation plan for postmortem: - permanent tenant-level guardrails (batch size/concurrency limits) - autoscaler tuning to react faster - add alert for per-tenant batching anomalies - contact customer for RCA draft.

Maya (sre): I'll keep monitoring and mark this as mitigated once next 15m stable. assigning follow-up to eng-runtime (Jordan) and ops (Luis) for next-day fixes.

deploy-bot: ASG scale event: group=dedicated-west-2a nodes_added=2 timestamp=3520004850

Maya (sre): 15m stable window passed. 5xx rate steady at 2.8%. marking as mitigated in chat. I'll open the postmortem with timeline and assign owners.

Anna (customer-success): Arcadia confirmed errors reduced and traffic normalizing. Customer happy with temporary fix and asked for ETA on permanent guardrail. I'll coordinate SLA-safe timeline. :phone:
